chunks.text: Independently verify reported neural-network accuracy by restoring the saved checkpoint and running inference again on the exact held-out test examples. Compare recomputed predictions with the metrics report and bind the checkpoint to the recorded source code, configuration and dataset fingerprint. A plausible number in a metrics JSON file alone does not prove that the trained weights achieved it.

Keep the final test split completely outside feature selection, normalization fitting and hyperparameter tuning. Fit preprocessing on training data and use a separate validation set to select settings. Looking at the final test results while selecting a model leaks information and makes the final accuracy estimate optimistic.

For a small CPU-only smoke experiment, train an MLP and a convolutional classifier on the same fixed subsets with comparable epoch and sample budgets. Record each architecture, seed and elapsed time. This run checks execution and artifact generation; its tiny dataset accuracy must not be presented as a full scientific benchmark or a GPU result.

When an experiment returns invalid metrics but the approved source snapshot is already durable, retain that source and retry only the failed experiment stage. Record a new attempt and audit its results before publication. Do not silently regenerate previously approved code or erase the failed attempt from history.

A citation number is only a pointer, not proof of a claim. Save the source passage and bind each cited assertion to the excerpt that supports it. Check the text's relevance, the passage identity and the location of the citation in the report. A valid citation pointing to an unrelated passage cannot substantiate the assertion.

A durable agent should persist measured usage and pending reservations before dispatching more work. On restart, reload existing charges rather than resetting the budget counter. Stop when the allowed ceiling would be exceeded and preserve incomplete operations for explicit recovery. Reservations are accounting safeguards, not a substitute for actual provider usage.

Keep provider credentials in local secret configuration and use them only through the authentication mechanism. Exclude the .env file, private design documents and credential values from model prompts, generated code, exported reports and Git commits. Public template configuration may list empty key names but must never contain real secrets.

Actual neural semantic retrieval computes document and query embeddings with a real pretrained model, searches the resulting vector index and optionally scores text pairs with a cross-encoder. A prerecorded list of result identifiers tests the scoring code but does not measure model inference or retrieval quality. Measure relevance against independent labels, and keep ranking metrics distinct from engineering-path checks.
梯度累积把一个大批次拆为多个小批次，先逐次计算梯度而不立即更新参数，累计规定次数后再执行一次优化器更新并清零。损失通常按累积次数缩放，以保持与大批次训练相近的梯度尺度。这样可以在显存有限时模拟较大的有效批次，但不是简单地提高学习率。
早停根据验证集指标选择训练终点。若验证损失连续若干轮没有改善，达到预先规定的耐心次数，就停止训练并恢复验证表现最好的检查点。应提前确定监控指标、最小改善幅度和耐心次数，不用最终测试集来决定何时停止。
类别不平衡时，总体准确率可能主要反映多数类别，掩盖对稀有类别的漏检。评估应同时报告各类别的精确率、召回率、混淆矩阵，以及宏平均 F1 或平衡准确率。宏平均给每个类别相同权重，能够更清楚地暴露少数类别表现不足。
可复现实验需要保存 Python、NumPy 和训练框架的随机种子、数据划分、模型配置、软件版本及源码摘要。比较多个模型时应尽量使用同一数据划分和明确的种子策略。固定种子并不能保证所有硬件或并行实现都逐位一致，因此还应记录确定性设置和执行环境。
工作区路径校验必须拒绝绝对路径与父目录跳转，解析规范化后的真实目标，并确认它仍在允许的目录内。还应防止符号链接或其他重解析点把路径导向工作区之外。校验和读写应保持明确的权限边界，不能仅凭用户传来的字符串前缀判断安全。
学习率预热在训练最初的若干步使用较小学习率，再逐步提高到目标值，以缓和初始阶段不稳定的梯度更新。预热之后可以按预定衰减策略调整学习率。应记录预热步数和目标学习率；它不同于监控验证损失并提前停止训练。
混合检索可以并行获取稠密向量相似度排名与 BM25 词项排名。两路原始得分的量纲不同，不宜直接相加；倒数排名融合根据每条结果在各路中的名次计算融合分数。随后可以用重排模型评估相同候选文本，但重排不能找回候选集中没有的相关内容。
共用的原始数据集应以只读方式挂载到实验环境，使训练脚本无法覆盖样本。模型检查点、图片和指标等新产物写入独立工作区或专用输出卷。执行结束后只清理本轮拥有的临时资源，保留共享数据集和需要审计的实验产物。

A training-curve image plots losses or accuracies recorded during learning. Check axis labels, units, legends and image format so the curve can be read. Creating a valid PNG is not independent confirmation of the underlying measurements or saved model predictions.

Database pagination divides a long result list into pages. A cursor can encode the stable ordering position, and an index can accelerate fetching the next page. This is a storage query technique, not neural-network gradient accumulation or an experiment data split.
文件压缩通过编码减少存储或传输字节，解压后应检查文件完整性和路径。归档大小并不是模型准确率，也不能说明某个神经网络检查点在测试集上的推理表现。压缩设置与训练的学习率预热是不同概念。
后台服务的心跳用来表明进程仍在运行，租约超时可以帮助协调工作者所有权。心跳本身不证明论文引用正确、分类器预测正确或实验已经达到质量目标。运行状态与结果正确性应分别记录。
